label: DR-009
note: The gemini provider intentionally declares npm @ai-sdk/google while being pointed at an OpenAI-compatible gateway — opencode is provider-agnostic transport and the SDK label does not dictate the host. The reviewer must NOT flag a provider/SDK mismatch, suggest switching to @ai-sdk/openai-compatible, or claim the committed config is missing a baseURL. Two files are needed to present that shape honestly: assets/opencode.json (which mirrors the real file and carries NO baseURL) and the setup-opencode-config.sh excerpt that injects it at install time (LADR-034). Fixture history: it once shipped a static "baseURL": "{env:OPENCODE_GEMINI_URL}" in the committed config, which the DR-009 context injected alongside it explicitly calls a design violation — the reviewer was flagging a real contradiction, and the fixture was failing for being wrong rather than for re-raising DR-009. Keep both files in agreement with the DR text and with the real repo.
